metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy two-move exercise that can quickly relieve muscle pain in-between the shoulder blades.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and is perfect to use daily to keep the shoulder blade muscles nice and loose.

Let us know how it works for you!
